metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows the best back exercises you can do at work, using NO EQUIPMENT!

If you're dealing with a lot of back aches, tightness, stiffness at work and need a quick fix, this is a video that you're not going to want to miss. 

We're going to go over easy, effective back exercises that will be broken down into a step-by-step guide, each targeting a difference area of the back. That way you can target the full back, or just use what's needed. 

The great part is the exercises don't require any special equipment, can be done at a desk in a chair, and may give quick relief -- even in as little as 30 SECONDS!

Watch now for the best back exercises to do at work!

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
0:33 Base of Neck
2:48 Upper and Middle Back
4:55 Shoulder Blades
7:05 Low Back and Hips
9:45 Sacroiliac (SI) Joints
